scope: Read-only installed ROS endpoint and retained solution/current scene audit. No planning, execution, motion, IO, deployment or live source mutation.
execution_rejection: world collision geometry or octomap changed
topic_registration: execute_task consistently registered and published as the exact endpoint key; resolves ROS /execute_task at root namespace
finding: Exact ROS message equality rejects harmless quaternion serialization rounding, at <=6.94e-18 per coefficient, between the MTC start scene and GetPlanningScene. All collision shapes, dimensions, IDs, frames, poses other than these 3 coefficients, metadata and empty octomap match.
